semiconductor_relevance: High — Magnescale provides advanced measurement and inspection equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Magnescale specializes in high-precision measurement and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their products include a new Z-sensor for 3D measurement systems and a non-contact self-calibrating rotary encoder, both designed for ultra-precision applications in machining and inspection.
capabilities: Z-sensor for 3D measurement systems with six degrees of freedom
Non-contact self-calibrating rotary encoder with high angular accuracy
Linear and angle encoders for ultra-precision machining
High-precision digital probes for real-time measurement
